scope: Condition coverage tool and tests only. No source data, monetary index, row identity tool, seal, or interim worktree changes.

verifiedBehavior.beforeSourceBindings: All four contract rows match full sourceInput path/SHA/pointer, explicit row-audit UID plus declared and actual row-audit triples, current index position, and before condition values. --before writes only to a fresh explicit output; frozen V2 SHA stayed unchanged.
verifiedBehavior.negativeControls: Source path/SHA/pointer drift, declared row-audit UID/triple/index drift, and actual row-audit input/hash/pointer drift cannot produce an exact binding.
verifiedBehavior.currentMode: Validates research/monetary-source-inventory.json with the existing inventory CLI --check and loads the live audit with loadMonetaryRowIdentityAudit. Changed condition, source hash, and current path/pointer mismatches are needs-independent-review. The four frozen contract statuses remain present; current row-audit findings and review outcomes are emitted as distinct dimensions.
verifiedBehavior.fieldAbsence: Null, deleted, empty, or rephrased condition values never confer a semantic pass. All general semantic completeness remains unassessed.
verifiedBehavior.fourInfoRows: Each exact row UID reports the typed-content finding dmg-p33-information-discovery-note-conditions as confirmed-typed-content-mismatch, separately from row-focus and source-context findings.
verifiedBehavior.currentCliExecution: Default CLI was exercised. The current index artifact is absent in this checkout, so inventory validation stopped before creating artifacts/monetary-condition-coverage/report.json; no frozen artifact was overwritten.

limits: This tool is a projection and exact-reference checker, not a generic source-semantic detector.
The current default report cannot be generated until research/monetary-source-inventory.json exists and passes its canonical --check.
